notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Sage of the Maze and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
